purpose: Extend the existing nonconstant-wave full-moment PDE diagnostic beyond T=.05; separate numerical failure from mathematical divergence
method: independent six-component moment PDE, centered Laplacian, explicit RK4 at dt<=.2 dx², terminal and tail data inherited from previous diagnostic; integrate once to largest horizon per configuration, store exact horizon hits
safety_stop: stop a deterministic configuration if a component exceeds 1e12 or becomes nonfinite; retain every later requested horizon as not reached; this is a numerical failure indicator, never a proof of infinite moments
interpretation: static-supported policy is not the spatial terminal proxy and has no general dominance guarantee on wave data; comparisons are diagnostics, not validated certificates; best among three tested rates is not a continuous-rate optimum
